Use Reference Image 1 (character holding product) and Reference Image 2-3 (original product closeups) as strict visual anchors: Position the character ({character_desc}) in the UPPER-MIDDLE zone (top 68% of the frame), smiling warmly and holding the exact product ({product_name}) clearly toward the camera. Preserve 100% authentic product texture, weave, shape, and color. Product USP: {product_info}. Keep the bottom 30% of the frame clean worktable space for the 3-photo product detail showcase grid.
